title: Toledo HCC hydrogen compressors: increase recycle gas in the installed frames
source: Gupta, Starling, Svaan and Higgins, 29th Turbomachinery Symposium (2000); existing compressor and process data only
question: Increase recycle-hydrogen compression by about 12% without replacing the two installed compressor frames or their 3,500 hp motors. What limits, and what physical compressor scope reaches the target?
data_note: Real refinery reciprocating-compressor project. The paper publishes pressures, stage arrangement, cylinder sizes, motor ratings and before flow. Gas composition and full performance curves are not tabulated, so a DWSIM hydrogen-rich gas assay and compressor efficiencies must be explicit assumptions. The selected mechanical changes and shop/field performance are withheld.
suggested_questions: Which stage displacement limits the added recycle gas?
Can the installed motors carry the target?
Which cylinder or valve changes are mechanically credible?
